children: Novocure reported unauthorized access exposing internal patient ID numbers for over 1,400 U.S. records and other contact data; no device access or operational impact.
Unauthorized access in mid‑August exposed internal patient ID numbers for 1,400+ U.S. patient records; no patient names were disclosed.
Fewer than 50 western U.S. patient records contained additional identifying information; impacted patients will be notified as required.
General contact information for healthcare providers and employee job titles and phone numbers were accessed.
No access to medical treatment devices, operations remain fully functional, and company does not expect a material financial impact at this time.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
